text:
nina: quick bring-up note for apollo-11b-int4 (dev run finished) — need routing guidance for production

ryan: nice! baseline numbers?

nina: p50 55ms, p95 260ms (8k window); throughput ~580 tok/s; est cost $0.0039 per 1k tokens

ryan: compare to int8?

nina: int8 baseline p50 48ms p95 195ms tok/s 650 cost $0.0061 per 1k tokens

priya: big cost win (~36% lower) but tail & fidelity concerns. any evals?

nina: ran GTN short + task slices: multi-turn summarization ROUGE-L drop 1.3 pts, slot-filling/NER F1 down 0.8 pts, hallucination count up +1.1% on closure prompts

leo: summarization hit could matter for docs/sync products. where do errors concentrate?

nina: mostly long-context (>1500 tokens) condensation and entity recall on rare names. token-level ppl rises after 1024 tokens

ops-bot: candidate apollo-11b-int4 smoke -> metrics: cost_down, latency_tail_up, error_rate marginal

ryan: suggestion: hybrid routing by flow type + context length. rules: if context_len > 1200 -> int8; if flow == "high-assurance" (billing, legal, search-snippets) -> int8; else int4

priya: add a cheap classifier for flow type. we have prod labels for ~30% traffic, can train small distil model. keep threshold conservative e.g. highassurance_prob > 0.7 -> int8

leo: also recommend prefix cache cap on int4 (max_context 1024) to avoid kv thrash and p95 spikes

nina: agree. propose canary plan: 10% live traffic to int4 for non-high-assurance short-context flows, shadow 50% of requests to int4 for monitoring, auto-fallback to int8 on hallucination signal or fallback reasons >1%

ryan: scorecard before rollout pls. columns: slice, sample_size, metric_name, int8_value, int4_value, delta, pass/fail, routing_rule. we should include business-impact note (e.g., revenue-risk)

priya: I'll produce CSV w/ slices: summarization-long, summarization-short, ner-common, ner-rare, conversational-clari, code (block), documents-indexing

nina: additional note: quant artifacts show up in token-attn patterns for some pronoun resolution cases — might need layer-wise bias correction later

leo: ops todo: add flag apollo-int4-canary, implement routing policy hooks, set dashboards (latency by context_len, fallback-rate, hallucination-rate, quality-sample-clip)

ops-bot: rollout flags created: apollo-int4-canary. monitoring baseline snapshots captured

ryan: timeline: priya will post scorecard CSV by EOD tomorrow; ops implements routing + dashboards this week; start 10% canary Mon, review 7d metrics, expand to 40% if stable

priya: noted. product/GTN: prepare messaging/price update: "cost-optimized tier for everyday tasks; premium fidelity flows still default to fidelity tier"

nina: thanks. I'll attach sample diffs and the one-pager after priya's CSV so PMs can sign off

leo: +1. small ask: include a short list of worst-case sample examples so GTN can triage customer-facing notes

nina: will do. :thumbsup:
